name: Kanamic Network Co.,LTD
summary: Kanamic Network Co.,LTD operates as an application and communication service provider in the elderly care and medical care fields in Japan. It offers an elderly care system, including in-home elderly care support, home-visit services, outpatient day care, residential services, in-facility services, community-based services, welfare equipment, and disabilities support services; elderly care software; and a system for community support centers. The company also provides a childcare support system, which offers cloud service support for raising children, comprising information distribution, consultation, and child growth tracking functions, as well as a medical care system for in-home care. In addition, it provides systems integration and solutions, website creation and operational services, management and systems consulting services, paid job placement services, and education and training services. Further, the company is involved in the planning, production, and sale of web content, videos, and various sales promotion tools, as well as the planning and conducting of lectures, seminars, academic meetings, etc. Kanamic Network Co.,LTD was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
